input_prompt: Design a time travel game with: branching timelines, paradox resolution, butterfly effects, temporal weapons, historical eras, timeline stabilization

rules.name: Temporal Integrity
rules.description: Players must not disrupt the timeline in significant ways.

rules.name: Paradox Prevention
rules.description: Players must resolve paradoxes before they cause damage to the timeline.

rules.name: Butterfly Effect
rules.description: Small changes to the timeline can have significant effects on the future.

rules.name: Temporal Weapon Limitations
rules.description: Temporal weapons can only be used in specific historical eras and for specific purposes.

interactions.result: Player is transported to a new historical era.
Player uses a temporal weapon to alter the timeline.
Player resolves a paradox and prevents damage to the timeline.
Player observes the effects of a small change to the timeline.

transitions.trigger: Player chooses a new era to travel to
Player arrives in a new era

implementation_steps: Implement the Timeline System and its components.
Create the Character System and its components.
Develop the Environmental System and its components.
Implement the Interactions and their results.
Create the State Machine and its transitions.
